Name: Diver's Best Friend - Automated Stratagem System (ASS)
Description: Revision 46: HUD Plus 0.2.8 / 0.2.9 list/picker compatibility; Custom Stratagem Compendium 0.4.1 / HD2Runtime 0.40.0 code ownership support; exhausted stratagem state and Foliage Pass-Through 1.0 donor compatibility. All compatibility mods are optional. Retains bounded UI recovery, native guards, streamlined options, blacklist settings and existing bindings. Requires Mod Options Menu, Mod Bindings Menu v2 or newer (API 1) and a compatible shared loader. Install one ASS loader variant and restart after updates.
